messages:
Lina: Quick sketch dropped for an alternative 'access grid' (matrix-like) instead of the heavy roles table. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newgrid (frame: access-grid-v1). Main goals: scanability, fewer columns, clearer invite affordances. Noah: This looks promising. Two quick concerns: 1) bulk CSV actions might get lost in a compact grid. 2) SSO toggle copy needs to be explicit about password disallowance. Zoe: Agree on bulk CSV discoverability. Idea: keep a persistent small "Import CSV" chip next to the search when CSV history exists. Also show a one-line hint under the Invite button for admins: "Supports CSV import". Priya: A11y things: if we reduce row density, make sure row focus states are prominent and virtualization doesn't remove focusable elements. Also modal focus should go to the first input (role selection) and aria-live region for success toasts. Omar: For SSO language, we should use: `Enforce SSO sign-in for all org members` + secondary text: `This disables password login. Configure IdP in Security → SSO.` Simple. Also toast after toggle should include an explicit Undo and a link to the rollback doc. People flip security flags and panic. Lina: UX trade: grid reduces horizontal scroll but we lose explicit 'last active' column. Proposal: make activity a hover panel on desktop and an inline small timestamp for mobile. Use ISO format `YYYY-MM-DD` in compact view. Noah: Copy tweak: prefer "Assign role" instead of "Grant role". Less militaristic and clearer to new admins. Zoe: Keyboard shortcuts idea: `g r` to jump to Roles grid, `g a` to jump to Audit. Also map `i` to open Invite modal. We'll track as follow-up. Priya: ARIA snippet for the PR template we can reuse: ```
Invite sent
``` Also require contrast >= 4.5:1 for all icon-only buttons and visible focus ring in high-contrast/dark modes. Omar: Audit nav: prefer a sticky header with filters and a compact timeline mode (group by day) for long logs. That plus a keyboard focus trap for filters will make searching much faster. infra-bot: NOTE: Prototype updated -> access-grid-v1a. Accessibility annotations added for focus, aria-live, contrast checks. Lina: Nice. Action items: 1) Update figma with CSV chip + compact timestamp + SSO copy swap 2) Add Undo link to SSO toast + link to rollback doc 3) Copy sweep: Replace Grant -> Assign 4) Add ARIA snippets and checklist to the PR. I'll post updated link later today. Ping me to pair on the a11y checklist. :thumbsup:
